annotations.title: Generate DFARS 252.227-7017 & FAR 52.227-14 IP & Data Rights Assertion Table

description: Audit software components, AI/ML models and weights, firmware, technical data packages, and CDRL deliverables by development funding history (100% private expense, SBIR/STTR, mixed funding, or government-funded) to generate a 4-column DFARS 252.227-7017 Data Rights Assertion Table, verbatim DFARS 252.227-7013/7014/7018 and FAR 52.227-14 restrictive marking legends, a 10 U.S.C. 4401 Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA) boundary and DFARS 252.227-7027 deferred-ordering protection plan, and a pre-award IP negotiation checklist. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive Government Contracts IP compliance generator (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `software_modules_and_cdrl_deliverables_text` accepts 20 to 45,000 characters, while `governing_acquisition_regime` and `modular_open_systems_approach_mosa_context` calibrate DoD DFARS vs. Civilian FAR data rights rules and 10 U.S.C. 4401 open interface boundaries). Use this tool when building a proposal's DFARS 252.227-7017 / FAR 52.227-14 Data Rights Assertion Table, verbatim restrictive legends, or MOSA IP segregation plan; use `generate_sbir_sttr_commercialization` instead for full SBIR/STTR Phase I-III work plans, or `scan_far_dfars_clauses` for general Section I FAR/DFARS clause scanning.

governing_acquisition_regime.description: Applicable IP clause framework: DoD DFARS 252.227-7013/7014/7015/7017/7018 (SBIR) or Civilian FAR 52.227-14 / 52.227-19 (defaults to 'DoD_DFARS_252_227_7013_7014_7015_7017_And_7018').

modular_open_systems_approach_mosa_conte.description: 10 U.S.C. 4401 Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA) interface strategy separating open APIs/form-fit-function data from proprietary source code and model weights (defaults to 'MOSA_Open_API_Boundary_Preserving_Proprietary_Core_Algorithms').

software_modules_and_cdrl_deliverables_t.description: Inventory of software components, AI/ML models, weights, firmware, technical data packages, and CDRL deliverables with their development funding history (100% private expense, mixed funding, SBIR/STTR, or government-funded; 20 to 45,000 characters).

name: generate_data_rights_assertion_table

dfars_252_227_7017_assertion_table.description: Complete 4-column DFARS 252.227-7017 Identification and Assertion of Use, Release, or Disclosure Restrictions table.

ip_strategy_executive_overview.description: Executive summary of the data rights assertion posture, background IP protection, and MOSA alignment.

mosa_and_deferred_ordering_protection_pl.description: 10 U.S.C. 4401 MOSA interface boundary plan, black-box encapsulation strategy, and DFARS 252.227-7027/7037 audit defense.

pre_award_ip_negotiation_checklist.description: Pre-award checklist for submitting the signed DFARS 252.227-7017 attachment and negotiating Specially Negotiated License Rights.

restrictive_marking_and_legend_templates.description: Verbatim DFARS/FAR restrictive legends and placement instructions for source code, binaries, and technical data deliverables.

title: Generate DFARS 252.227-7017 & FAR 52.227-14 IP & Data Rights Assertion Table
